prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12, follow-up to ticket bdd0ed77930f: background_python() once returned the base interpreter (sys.prefix C:\Users\akien\AppData\Local\Python\pythoncore-3.14-64), not the venv, and a spawned bus died at import psycopg2.
